h1: CAMPUS · The Documents Behind OY, Kept
title: CAMPUS | The Documents Behind OY, Kept | Heuremen LLC
desc: CAMPUS: every external source cited on the OY page, read and kept pass after pass so that a moved, changed or removed page shows.
intro_html:
Do the pages schools published stay where they were?

The OY page lists what colleges and universities have published about their own AI policies and about measuring them, with a source link for every row. Those sources are web pages and PDFs that their owners can move, rewrite or remove. We read every external source on the OY page, keep what each one said, and read it again on later passes, so that a change shows and so that the OY Matrix can be kept right.
note_html: This is a record, not a test. It never ranks or judges a school. A page changed when the overlap of its three-word sequences with the previous read is below 0.90, so dates, menus and counters can move it a little. A page that is not found may have been moved. A blocked page refused our request, which names this site and does not disguise itself, and tells us nothing about the page. Why a page changed is not measured here. Every gone page and every page rewritten past one half is read in full and listed. Plan, addenda and code.
